info.title: LiteFW Management API
info.description: LAN-only JSON API. HTTP Basic credentials or an X-API-Key token authenticate. For API keys use HTTPS or a trusted encrypted tunnel: plain HTTP exposes secrets. Keys are read or admin; key management and password/management changes always require Basic. All changes use POST with X-LiteFWM: 1.
